import json, subprocess, sys, time

def cfg(**kw):
    c = {"early":False,"overlap":"reject","buffer_packets":16,"idle_ms":0,
         "max_streams_bidi":1024,"max_streams_uni":1024,"max_stream_data":65536,
         "max_data":4611686018427387903,"crypto_limit":65536,"sent":{"I":[],"H":[],"A":[]}}
    c.update(kw); return c

# 2 MiB total data spread over 32 traces: 32 frames of 2048 bytes each per trace
traces = []
total_frames = 0
total_pkts = 0
for ti in range(32):
    events = [{"t":0,"op":"key","level":"A","action":"install"}]
    t = 1
    pn = 0
    for j in range(32):   # 32 frames of 2048 bytes -> 64 KiB per trace
        fr = [{"type":"CRYPTO","offset":j*2048,"data_hex":"ab"*2048}]
        events.append({"t":t,"op":"datagram","bytes":1200,"packets":[{"level":"A","pn":pn,"auth":True,"frames":fr}]})
        pn += 1; t += 1; total_frames += 1; total_pkts += 1
    # fill with PING frames: 60000 total frames - 1024 data frames
    while total_frames < 60000:
        fr = [{"type":"PING"}]*32
        events.append({"t":t,"op":"datagram","bytes":1200,"packets":[{"level":"A","pn":pn,"auth":True,"frames":fr}]})
        pn += 1; t += 1; total_frames += 32; total_pkts += 1
    while len(events) < 20000//32:
        events.append({"t":t,"op":"tick"}); t += 1
    traces.append({"id":"t%d"%ti,"config":cfg(),"events":events})
doc = {"version":1,"traces":traces}
raw = json.dumps(doc).encode()
print("input bytes:", len(raw), "frames", total_frames, "pkts", total_pkts,
      "events", sum(len(t["events"]) for t in traces))
t0=time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I","/app/submission/entry.py"], input=raw, capture_output=True)
print("rc",p.returncode,"time %.2fs"%(time.time()-t0),"outlen",len(p.stdout), p.stderr[:200])
out=json.loads(p.stdout)
print("error" if "error" in out else "ok", len(out.get("results",[])))
EOF
